Procedure title: Request for Tender for The Supply, Delivery and Commissioning of No. Three Hydraulics / Electro-Hydraulics Training Systems with Simulation and Software
Description: The Supply, Delivery and Commissioning of No. Three Hydraulics / Electro-Hydraulics Training Systems with Simulation and Software to Kerry College Monavalley Campus on behalf of Kerry ETB, • Supply of one (1) complete hydraulics / electrohydraulics training system comprising the base system (Section 3) and the five component compositions (Section 4).
